_comment: Headline, subline and layout per screenshot and locale. compose.swift reads the raw capture from screenshots/raw/<lang>/ and fails if it is missing — no silent fallback to another language, that would put English captures into a translated store. 'theme' picks the ground (light = pale mint, dark = brand gradient), 'layout' the composition (hero, text-top, frame-top, highlight). 'card' describes the magnified crop used by the highlight layout: 'rect' is [left, top, right, bottom] normalised to 0…1 of the capture, 'scale' how much it grows, 'y' overrides the card centre normalised to canvas height.
